name: TPB
title: Tigress Island #1
desc: Welcome to paradise. Try not to bleed on the beach. A group of down-on-their-luck actresses are abducted and taken to Tigress Island—a remote prison compound ruled by a sadistic female warden where manipulation is currency and survival comes at a cost. Forced into uneasy alliances, the women must work together to escape the island’s brutal power structure… but paranoia, buried resentments, and competing agendas threaten to destroy them long before freedom is within reach. From PATRICK KINDLON (GEHENNA) and EPHK (HARPY) comes a ridiculously fun, seriously sexy action-adventure perfect for fans of BITCH PLANET, Send Help, Survivor, and 1970s exploitation films. Collects TIGRESS ISLAND #1-5
